rawContent: WEIGH IN: Is there a road to redemption for those indicted in the #MeToo movement? If so, what do they need to do or say to make things right?

.@TheRaDR says #MeToo men have only made "half-hearted first steps" on the path to redemption. "All of these statements are like, 'I'm so sorry to have hurt my fans, I feel ashamed, the impact has been on my family,' and they're not taking responsibility." https://t.co/eiNAFZFmtZ
